name: ST NUCLEO-H743ZI2 (Nucleo-144)
description: Obsolete 480 MHz Cortex-M7 Nucleo-144 with Ethernet RJ45, USB OTG and ST-LINK; ST now recommends the otherwise identical NUCLEO-H753ZI (adds crypto).
notes: Marked obsolete/NRND by ST and DigiKey (DigiKey names NUCLEO-H753ZI as the replacement; ST says a project for the ZI2 loads on the H753ZI unchanged apart from crypto). Price is the last distributor/aggregator quote and stock is only grey-market or old inventory.
STM32H743ZIT6 (LQFP144); Zio (Arduino Uno V3 superset) plus ST morpho headers; 100 GPIO is an estimate of what reaches the connectors.
The KiCad symbol is the original NUCLEO-H743ZI; the footprint is the common Nucleo-144 morpho connector footprint.
